purpose: A bounded public record of independently checkable artifacts, releases, commits, deployments, and provenance.

methodology.rule: Every entry must identify exactly what the linked evidence proves. Evidence of existence is not evidence of commercial success, scientific validity, customer adoption, or capability beyond the cited artifact.
methodology.claim_boundary: No entry may upgrade a source into a stronger claim than the source supports.

entries.title: Truth Compiler bounded release governor
entries.claim: The public truth-compiler-ai repository contains a merged commit for a bounded Protector release governor, preceded by tests for replay and capability boundaries and CI coverage.

entries.title: Victor Heartbeat v1 canonical architecture
entries.claim: Victor Heartbeat v1 is merged into dev-ville main with the reviewed Truth Compiler v1 pinned by immutable merge commit and SHA-256. The exact pre-merge Heartbeat, Driver, organ-contract, and consent-ledger workflows completed successfully. This proves the merged bounded architecture and tested integration path; it does not prove AGI, consciousness, unrestricted autonomy, or production reliability beyond the cited tests.

entries.title: Victor bounded Remediation Control Plane v1
entries.claim: RCP v1 is merged into dev-ville main on top of canonical Victor Heartbeat after fresh RCP, Heartbeat, Driver, organ-contract, and consent-ledger workflows passed on the rebased exact head. The implementation is bounded to governed remediation and draft-PR publication; this record does not claim merge, deploy, secret, fund, organization-permission, or self-verification authority.

entries.title: Victor Operator v0.1 bounded local execution substrate
entries.claim: Victor Operator v0.1 is merged into VICTOR-SSI main after dedicated cross-platform Operator CI and the repaired component-capability matrix both passed on the rebased exact head. The runtime is a bounded local execution substrate and does not own Victor identity, cognition, final authority, independent verification, or canonical history; hosted cognition remains fail-closed.

entries.title: Shared Completion Fabric v1 portfolio intelligence
entries.claim: SCF-1 is merged into starpower-core after Python 3.11 and 3.12 lint/tests, a public MASSIVEMAGNETICS owner-repository portfolio scan, leverage summary, and artifact publication passed on the exact head. SCF is advisory portfolio intelligence; its automatic mutation boundary is limited to allowlisted support-file creation. The public owner scan does not prove visibility of private or otherwise non-visible repositories.

entries.title: VictorOS Android v0.1 permissionless baseline
entries.claim: VictorOS Android v0.1 is merged after the exact-head workflow built a non-empty debug APK and verified the merged APK requests zero Android permissions, disables normal application backup, and disables cleartext traffic. Physical-device install, OEM/runtime behavior, and force-stop/restart continuity have not yet been recorded as evidence and are not claimed by this entry.

entries.title: Git-anchored research provenance registry
entries.claim: The site repository contains a commit explicitly publishing a research provenance registry with artifact fingerprints, a deterministic record-set root, browser verification, sitemap registration, and CI proof checks.

entries.title: Truth Compiler proof and privacy funnel
entries.claim: The live-site repository records deployment of a proof-driven audit funnel, public case-study surfaces, customer privacy/data-rights policy, service terms, product manifest, and post-checkout routing.

entries.title: Amplification Governor owner control plane
entries.claim: The live-site repository records deployment of a local-first owner control plane with Idea Vault, Branch Governor, preservation states, audit trail, reactivation triggers, receipts, exports, and data-quality controls.
